newsitem.title: USA: Western Resources unit lifts ADT Ltd stake.
newsitem.headline: Western Resources unit lifts ADT Ltd stake.

text.p: Westar Capital Inc said on Tuesday it had raised its stake in ADT Ltd to 27 percent, or 38,077,611 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Westar said it most recently bought 4,092,200 shares of ADT and 500 units of liquid yield option notes exchangeable for 14,115 ADT shares, for a total of $79.9 million.
It said it made the latest share purchases October 8-28 at prices ranging from $19.125 to $19.75 a share.
Westar is a unit of Western Resources Inc, which opposed Republic Industries Inc's proposed acquisition of ADT.
On September 30 Republic and ADT terminated their proposed $5 billion merger.
